scope: Post-primary descriptive supplement completing the goal’s explicit within-leaf stratified reporting; original primary unchanged. Not a new blinded or confirmatory test.
fixed_scope: All nine loci, all sixteen global candidate assignments, four features, shared canonical values; retain every physical leaf and all nine same-leaf pairs.
estimand: Within each physical leaf with both classes, mean four-feature agreement over same-label pairs minus mean over different-label pairs. Only f99 qualifies; do not average a fabricated zero from other leaves or pool all nine pairs. Also report separate class mean-agreement bounds where that class exists.
decomposition: Use identical same/different weights for jointly-present and jointly-absent contributions; their sum equals D99 at one consistent endpoint witness. Separate extrema not added.
bounds: Within each one of16 full global candidate assignments enumerate allowed shared canonical bits per feature; average four feature extrema; then envelope over full candidates. Conservative Cartesian relaxation, not sharp geometry bounds or statistical interval. Never combine independent pair interval endpoints.
missingness: For each scenario and each of9 loci, report all4 values and counts1/0/unknown. Also report unique selected canonical groups and by-feature unknown canonical-variable counts; distinguish9node opportunities from8or9unique drawing groups.
unchanged: No altered labels, candidate roster, thresholds, primary weights or unknown handling
No significance test or semantic claim
